_note: Relevance proxy: a returned event counts as relevant if its caption contains any of `relevant_keywords` (case-insensitive substring, whole-word). This is a weak proxy (not human-verified ground truth) because captions are generated at index time by Florence-2 and aren't known until you run the pipeline. Good enough to compare vector-only vs hybrid RRF on the SAME index; not good enough to claim absolute retrieval quality without manual spot-checking of ~10 results.
